ProductPre-orderSales disclosure

PRIVACY

Data with a defined purpose.

The public product pages do not require an account. The following processing applies when the pre-order system is opened.

Data processed

The order system records an order identifier, selected product, amount, accepted terms version, timestamps, payment status, and Stripe identifiers. A daily salted hash derived from the network address limits abusive reservation attempts; the original network address is not stored in the order database.

Payment and delivery information

Stripe Checkout collects the buyer email, phone number, shipping address, and payment information. Card data is handled by Stripe and is not stored in the avocadoMini order database.

Purpose and retention

Data is used to process payment, maintain reservation capacity, confirm order status, handle refunds or disputes, prevent abuse, and support delivery. Abuse-control records expire from the active database after two days. Transaction records are retained only while required for order operations, disputes, accounting, security, or applicable legal obligations.

Contact and requests

Before sales open, the legal seller identity and direct contact details will appear on the sales disclosure page. Current project inquiries may be sent through Instagram @kirin.41.
